inputs.doc: E-021b: re-run the 20-year fan with SPATIALLY CORRELATED perturbations. E-021 perturbed each section pixel independently, but z is strongly correlated along the section (measured on run-62: r 0.99 at 1 cell, 0.88 at 5, 0.35 at 80; N_eff ~ 2.5 of 265 pixels), so white noise averaged down by sqrt(265)~16x against the true sqrt(2.5)~1.6x — a ~10x under-dispersion built into the METHOD, which E-021 reported as a model failure. This resamples the head own one-step residual FIELDS instead, carrying the real spatial and cross-dimension covariance with nothing fitted. Falsifier: if 90% coverage stays near 19% and the band stays near 0.9 Sv, the under-dispersion is the model contractive dynamics and E-021 verdict stands unchanged; if coverage rises toward 90% and the band toward ~9 Sv, the calibration claim was my bug and must be retracted. The memorisation finding is untouched either way (it concerns the median, not the spread).
